title: Session Security: prediction, flags and replay
description: Predictable session IDs, cookies without HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite and JWTs the server never validates: four attacks against the session.

session-security-t01-q01.prompt: Log in normally (/login) twice in a row with curl -c and compare the session IDs. By how much do they increment?

session-security-t01-q02.prompt: Which session ID belongs to the admin account?

session-security-t01-q03.prompt: Set your cookie to the admin's session ID (/login?sid=X) and visit /whoami. Submit the flag.

2.title: Cookie flags and expired JWT replay

session-security-t02-q01.prompt: Which cookie flag would stop JavaScript from reading document.cookie (blocking XSS theft)?

session-security-t02-q02.prompt: Simulate the theft: send a valid session id to the attacker's collector /steal?c=X. Submit the flag.

session-security-t02-q03.prompt: Visit /api-jwt without a token, decode the payload of the JWT it hands you (base64). What year does it expire (exp field)?

session-security-t02-q04.prompt: Replay that same expired JWT to /api-jwt?token=X. Submit the replay flag.
